new_result.statement: If a d-dimensional kernel subspace is supported on m<=3 literal coordinates, one can condition on d selected original coordinates and write A=P^T C P with ||P||^2<=binom(m,d)<=3, preserving independent translated cap-one laws and giving s_k(C)>=s_k(A)/binom(m,d).
